 WBBL 2026: Match 24, ST W vs MS W Match Prediction – Who will win today’s WBBL match between Sydney Thunder Women vs Melbourne Stars Women?
 Sydney Thunder Women (ST W) take on Melbourne Stars Women (MS W) in match No. 24 of the ongoing Women's Big Bash League (WBBL) 2026 at the Drummoyne Oval in Sydney on Monday, November 16.
 By Adreej Kumar Mitra Published - 15 Nov 2026, 18:36 IST 
 6 Min Read
 Sydney Thunder Women vs Melbourne Stars Women (Photo Source: Ayush Kumar-Mark Brake/Getty Images) Sydney Thunder Women (ST W) take on Melbourne Stars Women (MS W) in match No. 24 of the ongoing Women's Big Bash League (WBBL) 2026 at the Drummoyne Oval in Sydney on Monday, November 16.
 Phoebe Litchfield-led Sydney Thunder have played five matches so far, winning two and losing three. They are placed at No. 6 on the points table and are currently on a three-match losing streak, which the would desperately want to end.
 Meg Lanning's Melbourne Stars have played six matches this season and have had a woeful campaign so far. They won their first game but have lost six in a row since then. The Stars find themselves at No. 7, only above the Hobart Hurricanes.

 Probable Top Performers from ST W vs MS W 
 Probable Best Batter: Meg Lanning 
 Meg Lanning has played six matches so far and scored 254 runs at an average of 42.33 and a strike rate of 121.53. The right-handed batter will look to set the foundation at the top of the order for the Melbourne Stars on Monday.
 Probable Best Bowler: Annabel Sutherland 
 Annabel Sutherland could be the key bowler in the upcoming game. The Australian all-rounder has picked up seven wickets in six matches at an average of 26.28 and an economy rate of 8.36. She will have an important role to play through the middle overs and at the death.
